{{Recipe}}

'''Quaker oat swallow''' is a Nigerian [[Cookbook:Swallow|swallow]] made from Quaker brand rolled oats. The oats are ground into powder form and cooked.

== Ingredients ==

* Water
* [[Cookbook:Rolled Oats|Rolled oats]], ground to a powder

== Procedure ==

# Bring the water to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] in a pot.
# Stir in the powdered oats until the mixture thickens. Continue stirring to prevent lumps.
# Add a very small amount of water, and cook for 5 minutes on low heat. Adding too much water will make the mixture too soft.
# Stir again to make sure the mixture is smooth.
# Remove from the heat and put in a wrapper.
# Serve with any soup of your choice.
